The table above shows the ages of $70$ employees at a company. What is the mean age, in years, of these employees?
explanation: Choice C is correct. The mean is the sum of values divided by the number of values. The sum is $9(18) + 15(19) + 10(20) + 15(21) + 10(22) + 11(23) = 162 + 285 + 200 + 315 + 220 + 253 = 1{,}435$. Dividing by $70$ gives $\frac{1{,}435}{70} = 20.5$.
